summary: Liturgy of the Hours feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed covering auth (401), index shape, hour detail, 404 for unknown hour/day, free+admin both 200 (not premium-gated), Lauds/Vespers psalmody DIFFERS per weekday, Compline IDENTICAL across all 7 days with psalms_vary_by_day=false. Frontend: discovered & fixed a CRITICAL JSX bug in /app/frontend/app/bible/index.tsx — when the new bible-liturgy-link Pressable was inserted, the surrounding `{SECTION_ORDER.map((sec) => {` opener was accidentally deleted, causing 'ReferenceError: sec is not defined' which crashed the entire Bible hub (red Error screen). After the fix, all UI flows work: bible-liturgy-link → /liturgy → 3 hour tiles + iBreviary external link → liturgy-reader-lauds (9 sections) → English/Latin/Side-by-Side mode toggles → 7 weekday chips change psalmody content (verified Mon vs Sun section-1 differ: 2915 vs 3490 chars) → Compline reader correctly hides ALL liturgy-day-* chips.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL JSX syntax error: '{SECTION_ORDER.map((sec) => {' opener was missing, causing 'ReferenceError: sec is not defined' and a full Bible hub crash (Uncaught Error overlay). This was introduced when the new bible-liturgy-link Pressable was inserted between the Mass Missals link and the section map. The bible-liturgy-link entry point was therefore completely unreachable for users. Reference: /app/frontend/app/bible/index.tsx:158 (now fixed by testing agent).

action_items: Main agent: please verify the JSX fix in /app/frontend/app/bible/index.tsx (line ~158, restored `{SECTION_ORDER.map((sec) => {` before `const list = grouped[sec];`). Consider adding a render smoke test for the Bible hub to catch this class of regression next time a new top-of-list link is added.

OPTIONAL: Bible hub now shows three top-level tiles (Mass Missals, Liturgy of the Hours, then book sections). Visual order is fine but you may want a small section header / divider between the two 'hub links' and the book grid for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/bible/index.tsx: SECTION_ORDER.map opener was lost during the liturgy-link insertion — a hard runtime crash on the Bible hub. Fixed by the testing agent.

/app/backend/liturgy_of_hours.py is large (~1500+ lines) due to embedded liturgical TEXT — acceptable since it's public-domain content, not logic. No DRY concerns; assembly is via small helpers (_section, _lauds_day).
All Liturgy endpoints correctly require auth and are NOT premium-gated, matching the product spec.
Frontend liturgy/[hour].tsx correctly hides the weekday selector when detail.psalms_vary_by_day === false (Compline). Verified UI.

rca_of_issue: Bible hub crash root cause: while inserting the new Liturgy of the Hours Pressable between the Mass Missals Pressable and the SECTION_ORDER.map() block in /app/frontend/app/bible/index.tsx, the line `{SECTION_ORDER.map((sec) => {` was inadvertently deleted along with the area being edited. The remaining `const list = grouped[sec];` became an orphan expression and Babel/JS treated `sec` as undefined at runtime. Reproduction: visit /bible without the fix → red 'Uncaught Error: sec is not defined' overlay, entire hub blank. Mitigation: restored the missing line; consider adding an automated render smoke test for major hub screens to catch this regression class.
